parsed.evidence_quote: We chose human serum albumin (HSA) as a model system for this study
We cross-linked human serum albumin (HSA) with the readily available cross-linker BS3-d0/4 in different heavy/light ratios.
cross-linked with mixtures of bis[sulfosuccinimidyl] suberate-d0 (BS3-d0) (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and its deuterated form bis[sulfosuccinimidyl] 2,2,7,7-suberate-d4 (BS3-d4)
The ratio of BS3-d4:HSA was 4:1 (by mass) in all three mixing ratios.
HSA does not require additional fractionation steps as larger proteins might.
